## Problem

What problem does this change solve?

## Evidence

How was the problem reproduced or measured?

## Change

What changed, and why is this the smallest sound solution?

## Validation

- [ ] Tests added or updated where behavior changed
- [ ] Relevant checks/builds run
- [ ] Documentation updated if needed

Validation details:

## Risk

What could regress? What should reviewers pay particular attention to?

## Security / privacy

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private logs, customer data, or personal information included
- [ ] Security-sensitive behavior has been considered
